descriptionEnglish: Factor for the Ashen Guild. Keeps her ledgers in three colours of ink, and will tell you exactly what each colour means if you ask her.
Warden of the lower weir for forty years. He has outlived three floods and fully expects to outlive the kilns.
Keeps the only inn in town with a roof that holds. Takes no side, serves both, and hears everything twice.
Kiln-mistress of the lower four terraces. She has burned charcoal for nineteen years and has never once been up to the top two after dark, which she will mention before you ask.

Keeps the downstream stretch alone, which is not how the wardens have ever done it. She counts the fish going up the ladder every morning and writes the number down, and the number has been the same for eleven days.
Holds the corner room at Sela's inn by the year and is in it perhaps one week in four. Answers every question politely, completely, and about something else.
